name: Savings Goal Calculator
description: Calculate the exact monthly or annual savings required to reach a target financial goal by a target date, given starting savings and interest rate.
search_intent: Calculate how much to save every month to reach a savings target or financial milestone.

outputs.label: Share of goal funded by compound interest (%)

calculation: Monthly rate i = annualRate / 100 / 12. Total months n = years × 12. Future value of current savings: FV_initial = currentSavings × (1 + i)^n. Net goal deficit = max(0, targetGoalAmount − FV_initial). If deficit is 0, required monthly payment PMT = 0. If i = 0, PMT = deficit / n. Otherwise, PMT = deficit × i / ((1 + i)^n − 1). Required annual savings = PMT × 12. Total user contributions = currentSavings + (PMT × n). Total interest earned = targetGoalAmount − totalUserContributions. Share funded by interest = (totalInterestEarned / targetGoalAmount) × 100.
limitations: Model assumes constant monthly contributions made at the end of each period.
Interest rates and investment yields are variable over time.
Inflation, tax on interest income, and capital gains deductions are not included in baseline projection.
